method: Avalanche - minimums on every card, all extra money to the highest-APR card
steps: Stop new charges on cards and new pay-later plans - use the Chase debit card day to day.
Pay PayPal Cashback ($90.57, 34%) and AAA Visa ($250.49) in full every month so they never charge interest.
Chase Amazon: always pay the Interest Saving Balance (now $295.33) - that keeps it at 0% interest.
Put every card's minimum on AutoPay so there are never late fees or penalty APRs.
As pay-later plans end (about $450/mo freed by January, about $820/mo by March), keep paying the same amount - just to the TARGET card.
Optional: a 0% balance-transfer card for Frontier/Capital One/Citi, or call Barclays and Capital One to ask for a lower APR.
